description: This file defines the 'Project' data model class used in a Flutter application. It includes properties for project details such as id, name, description, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with methods for copying, serialization to a map, and factory creation from a map. The class is designed to be immutable and can be used for handling project data within the application.
